question: How can the partless one be called with-parts-and-partless?
premises: Partless one through union with various eye-kalā becomes with-parts-and-partless.
inference: Thus the partless one is called with-parts-and-partless.
uncertainties: Internal sandhi in vicitredṛkkalāyogāt is not expanded.
plain_english: Even the partless one, through union with various eye-kalās, is called with-parts-and-partless; thus is the meaning.
